dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: At least tea and coffee taste good, right?

dialogues.speaker: Huatli
dialogues.text: Oh sure, that they do, and I love them too. Great way to jolt yourself awake.

dialogues.speaker: Huatli
dialogues.text: Ah... *yawn* Speaking of which, I'm getting sleepy again...

dialogues.speaker: Huatli
dialogues.text: Wait, no. I mean, I should go meditate again. Let's chat again when we get the chance, alright? See you!
